answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and let trust propagate through random walks of bounded length, so distant endorsements cannot amplify without limit. A Sybil cluster connected to honest participants by only a few attestations has a sparse external cut and low conductance; min-cut and transitivity bounds then cap its aggregate voting weight by its limited boundary flow, rather than its fabricated internal size. Even at dawn, an echo among accounts on one wharf adds no independent bridge.
